quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.summary: Repel the opening push before it reaches the Command Post. The board is watching the first exchange closely.

quests.title: Secure the Synergy Site
quests.summary: Take and hold the Siege Yard. Nothing gets built without it.

quests.title: Recover the Components
quests.summary: Three component classes, one Ratings Ram. Recover all three from the flank pocket.

quests.title: Clear the Forward Checkpoint
quests.summary: The checkpoint gates construction as much as the components do. Clear it.

quests.title: Build the Ratings Ram
quests.summary: Construction's authorized. Build the sponsor-branded problem solver before the wall segment.
